say:55:1360221015:1.text: I'm only doing this for you, my respected adversary. I'll honor my promise!

say:10:1360224002:1.text: It's been so long, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Even though I'm far away, I've heard all about your glorious adventures.
say:10:1360224002:1.male: It's been so long, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Even though I'm far away, I've heard all about your glorious adventures.
say:10:1360224002:1.female: It's been so long, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Even though I'm far away, I've heard all about your glorious adventures.

say:11:1360224003:1.text: I don't mean to disturb you, but an unusual phenomenon has occurred here, and I need your help to assess the situation.
say:11:1360224003:1.source_cn: 这次打扰，也是因为发现了些许异常，所以希望请你来评估一下。
say:11:1360224003:1.male: I don't mean to disturb you, but an unusual phenomenon has occurred here, and I need your help to assess the situation.
say:11:1360224003:1.female: I don't mean to disturb you, but an unusual phenomenon has occurred here, and I need your help to assess the situation.

say:12:1360224004:1.text: The other day, while heading to the temple, I passed by this place and heard some acolytes singing hymns.
say:12:1360224004:1.source_cn: 事情是这样的，我前些日子回归圣堂叙职，途中路过此处，恰...
say:12:1360224004:1.male: The other day, while heading to the temple, I passed by this place and heard some acolytes singing hymns.
say:12:1360224004:1.female: The other day, while heading to the temple, I passed by this place and heard some acolytes singing hymns.

say:13:1360224005:1.text: As you know, I used to be in a choir, so I'm quite familiar with hymns. It's obvious to me that the two acolytes were singing off-key.
say:13:1360224005:1.source_cn: 你知道，我是唱诗班出身，所以对圣歌非常的熟悉，那两位的...
say:13:1360224005:1.male: As you know, I used to be in a choir, so I'm quite familiar with hymns. It's obvious to me that the two acolytes were singing off-key.
say:13:1360224005:1.female: As you know, I used to be in a choir, so I'm quite familiar with hymns. It's obvious to me that the two acolytes were singing off-key.

say:14:1360224006:1.text: It's fine that their singing wasn't perfect, but the thing is, they were laughing and fooling around.
say:14:1360224006:1.source_cn: 唱歌走调并不是什么大问题，但，他们居然还在嘻嘻哈哈。
say:14:1360224006:1.male: It's fine that their singing wasn't perfect, but the thing is, they were laughing and fooling around.
say:14:1360224006:1.female: It's fine that their singing wasn't perfect, but the thing is, they were laughing and fooling around.

say:15:1360224007:1.text: I'd say that's an act of blasphemy.
say:15:1360224007:1.source_cn: 这就是极大的不尊重了。
say:15:1360224007:1.male: I'd say that's an act of blasphemy.
say:15:1360224007:1.female: I'd say that's an act of blasphemy.

say:16:1360224008:1.text: Temesia had me listen to them too. I might not have a perfect pitch, but I can definitely tell they were way off-key.
say:16:1360224008:1.source_cn: 特弥希娅让我也一起确认，我对音准的把握不算很准确，但也...
say:16:1360224008:1.male: Temesia had me listen to them too. I might not have a perfect pitch, but I can definitely tell they were way off-key.
say:16:1360224008:1.female: Temesia had me listen to them too. I might not have a perfect pitch, but I can definitely tell they were way off-key.

say:17:1360224009:1.text: She insists the acolytes were laughing at their own singing, but I didn't hear that.
say:17:1360224009:1.source_cn: 只是，她坚持说自己听到了修士们对走调不以为然甚至引以为...
say:17:1360224009:1.male: She insists the acolytes were laughing at their own singing, but I didn't hear that.
say:17:1360224009:1.female: She insists the acolytes were laughing at their own singing, but I didn't hear that.

say:18:1360224010:1.text: The weirdest part is that when we confronted them, they claimed there was nothing wrong with their singing.
say:18:1360224010:1.source_cn: 更奇怪的是，当我们去斥责他们的时候，他们坚持说没有任何发现。
say:18:1360224010:1.male: The weirdest part is that when we confronted them, they claimed there was nothing wrong with their singing.
say:18:1360224010:1.female: The weirdest part is that when we confronted them, they claimed there was nothing wrong with their singing.

say:19:1360224011:1.text: Here they are—the singing acolytes. I asked them to wait here so they can give you their accounts.
say:19:1360224011:1.source_cn: 这两位就是当事人，因为感觉不太对劲，所以我暂时让他们在...
say:19:1360224011:1.male: Here they are—the singing acolytes. I asked them to wait here so they can give you their accounts.
say:19:1360224011:1.female: Here they are—the singing acolytes. I asked them to wait here so they can give you their accounts.

say:21:1360224012:1.text: Temesia takes you to meet the acolytes, both of whom look aggrieved.
say:21:1360224012:1.source_cn: 在特弥希娅的引领下，你们看到了两位修士，他们都一脸委屈。

say:22:1360224013:1.text: Eager to explain themselves, the acolytes start prattling on as soon as you ask them about the situation.
say:22:1360224013:1.source_cn: 二人显然也忍耐了许久，一被问起，就立刻滔滔不绝地辩解起来。

say:23:1360224014:1.text: I-I really have no idea what Dame Temesia is talking about.
say:23:1360224014:1.source_cn: 我、我真的不知道特弥希娅圣骑士在说什么。

say:24:1360224015:1.text: Alright, I'm not a perfect singer, but I always sing hymns with the deepest devotion!
say:24:1360224015:1.source_cn: 好吧，我不能保证我的音准一定不会出错，但是在唱圣歌的时...

say:25:1360224016:1.text: I know Dura's watching, so there's no way I'd make a mockery of hymns!
say:25:1360224016:1.source_cn: 在艾雅的见证下，我怎么可能会拿圣歌取乐，甚至还嘻嘻哈哈？

say:26:1360224017:1.text: Just like Dame Temesia, I was once in a choir too. I may not be as experienced as her, but I've trained for much longer!
say:26:1360224017:1.source_cn: 别说嘻嘻哈哈了，我也是唱诗班出身，虽然不如特弥希娅圣骑...

say:27:1360224018:1.text: I'm quite confident to say I'm pitch-perfect. Throughout my life, my singing has never been off-key!
say:27:1360224018:1.source_cn: 我可以保证，我就是唱诗班的音准，长这么大，我的歌声从来...

say:29:1360224019:1.text: So, here's the deal—I'm sure I heard them laugh, and both Lucius and I heard their off-key singing.
say:29:1360224019:1.source_cn: 事情就是这样，我肯定听到了笑声，我和卢修斯都听到了跑调。

say:30:1360224020:1.text: But the acolytes don't seem to be lying either.
say:30:1360224020:1.source_cn: 但这两位兄弟姐妹也并不像说谎。

say:31:1360224021:1.text: We have to be careful since we're close to the rift, so I invited you here. Didn't expect you to show up this quickly.
say:31:1360224021:1.source_cn: 考虑到这里临近深渊裂隙，所以我以防万一，就写信邀请了你...
say:31:1360224021:1.male: We have to be careful since we're close to the rift, so I invited you here. Didn't expect you to show up this quickly.
say:31:1360224021:1.female: We have to be careful since we're close to the rift, so I invited you here. Didn't expect you to show up this quickly.

say:32:1360224022:1.text: Well, Magister happens to be dealing with similar issues in other places!
say:32:1360224022:1.source_cn: 因为呀，主人正在为了处理这系列的事务在奔波呢！

say:33:1360224023:1.text: We've got this, Temesia. Magister now has a weapon specially for this!
say:33:1360224023:1.source_cn: 放心吧，特弥希娅，主人现在有着专用武器！

narration:34:1360225001:1.text: Before the flustered crowd, you infuse magic into Dunlingr's bell.
narration:34:1360225001:1.male: Before the flustered crowd, you infuse magic into Dunlingr's bell.
narration:34:1360225001:1.female: Before the flustered crowd, you infuse magic into Dunlingr's bell.

narration:36:1360225002:1.text: The bell tolls, and light falls once again...
narration:36:1360225002:1.male: The bell tolls, and light falls once again...
narration:36:1360225002:1.female: The bell tolls, and light falls once again...

say:38:1360226001:2.text: As light blankets the land, everyone snaps out of a trance.
say:38:1360226001:2.source_cn: 随着光芒的笼罩，众人都露出了如梦方醒的神色。

say:40:1360226002:1.text: Horrendous figures of Hypofiends begin to emerge from the shadows around them...
say:40:1360226002:1.source_cn: 从他们身周的阴影中，浮现出了扭曲的魔物——

say:42:1360226003:1.text: The Hypogeans are indeed behind this!

say:1:1360227001:0.text: After the Hypofiends are repelled, the corrupt magic fades away, and everything falls back into place.
say:1:1360227001:0.source_cn: 驱逐魔物后，邪恶的气息消散，一切重归平静。

say:2:1360227002:1.text: After seeing the acolytes off, you explain everything to Temesia and Lucius.
say:2:1360227002:1.source_cn: 你们送走了两位修士，接着，向特弥希娅和卢修斯解释了一切...

say:4:1360227003:1.source_cn: 贝利尔……又是那个可憎的家伙！

say:5:1360227004:1.text: Thanks to the acolytes who've been praying around the clock to secure the seal, Berial's corrupt magic is effectively blocked.
say:5:1360227004:1.source_cn: 幸好看守封印的修士都日夜不停地祈祷着，神圣的气息能隔绝...

say:6:1360227005:1.text: Had Berial managed to possess them or even replace them, the seal would have been in serious danger.
say:6:1360227005:1.source_cn: 如果贝利尔能附到他们身上，甚至取而代之，那封印可就危险了。

say:7:1360227006:1.text: Fortunately, Temesia was sharp enough to notice the problem.
say:7:1360227006:1.source_cn: 幸好特弥希娅足够敏锐地发现了问题。

choice_prompt:8:1360227006.text: Fortunately, Temesia was sharp enough to notice the problem.
choice_prompt:8:1360227006.source_cn: 幸好特弥希娅足够敏锐地发现了问题。

say:9:1360227007:1.text: You're right. Besides the acolytes' off-key singing, it's strange that Lucius and I heard different things.
say:9:1360227007:1.source_cn: 是的，不止是唱歌的那两位，我和卢修斯听到的声音也不一样。
say:9:1360227007:1.male: You're right. Besides the acolytes' off-key singing, it's strange that Lucius and I heard different things.
say:9:1360227007:1.female: You're right. Besides the acolytes' off-key singing, it's strange that Lucius and I heard different things.

say:10:1360227009:1.text: Frankly speaking, I didn't even realize they were out of tune until Temesia pointed it out.
say:10:1360227009:1.source_cn: 事实上，我一开始甚至也没听出走调，是特弥希娅提醒了我以...

say:11:1360227010:1.text: Maybe it's because every time I sing, I can only hear my own loud voice. I rarely pay attention to others.
say:11:1360227010:1.source_cn: 因为我声音很大，基本一唱歌就只能听到自己的声音了，很少...

say:12:1360227011:1.text: Hmm... Could I be possessed? Not likely, right?!
say:12:1360227011:1.source_cn: 嘶……难道是我被附体了？不会吧？！

say:13:1360227012:1.text: We can't get caught up in this vicious cycle of second-guessing, or we'll be playing right into Berial's hands.
say:13:1360227012:1.source_cn: 我和卢修斯不能陷入这种猜疑与质证的循环当中，否则肯定正...

say:14:1360227013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, is there a way to detect corrupted beings like you just did?
say:14:1360227013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, is there a way to detect corrupted beings like you just did?
say:14:1360227013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, is there a way to detect corrupted beings like you just did?

say:16:1360227014:1.text: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?
say:16:1360227014:1.source_cn: 顿里尔大人的钟也用了，还能有什么办法呀，主人？
say:16:1360227014:1.male: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?
say:16:1360227014:1.female: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?

choice_prompt:17:1360227014.text: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?
choice_prompt:17:1360227014.source_cn: 顿里尔大人的钟也用了，还能有什么办法呀，主人？
choice_prompt:17:1360227014.male: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?
choice_prompt:17:1360227014.female: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?

say:18:1360227015:1.text: Singing... together? Can't say singing with Lucius is all that enjoyable.
say:18:1360227015:1.source_cn: 一起唱圣歌……吗，虽然和卢修斯一起演唱不算什么愉快的体验。
say:18:1360227015:1.male: Singing... together? Can't say singing with Lucius is all that enjoyable.
say:18:1360227015:1.female: Singing... together? Can't say singing with Lucius is all that enjoyable.

say:19:1360227016:1.text: But he's still a much better option than Atalanta. That girl is literally tone-deaf, I'm afraid.
say:19:1360227016:1.source_cn: 但，总比调子都跑到白山公国的阿塔兰忒强多了。
say:19:1360227016:1.male: But he's still a much better option than Atalanta. That girl is literally tone-deaf, I'm afraid.
say:19:1360227016:1.female: But he's still a much better option than Atalanta. That girl is literally tone-deaf, I'm afraid.

say:20:1360227017:1.text: That doesn't really reassure me, Temesia.
say:20:1360227017:1.source_cn: 我可不觉得你是在夸我，特弥希娅。

say:21:1360227018:1.text: Alright, let's begin! Hope it works...
say:21:1360227018:1.source_cn: 好了，开始吧！希望能有效果……

narration:22:1360228001:0.text: Temesia kicks off the song, and Lucius soon follows with his deep, sonorous voice.
narration:22:1360228001:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅起了个头，卢修斯紧跟着，用响亮的声音加入。

narration:23:1360228002:0.text: The singing is anything but perfect, yet the song gradually fills the air with a sense of purity...
narration:23:1360228002:0.source_cn: 那歌声绝对谈不上多么美妙，但在特弥希娅的引领下，气氛逐...

narration:25:1360228003:0.text: Without warning, a scream shatters the silence as a figure emerges from Temesia's shadow...
narration:25:1360228003:0.source_cn: 紧接着，随着一声大叫，从特弥希娅的影子里滚出来了一个人影——

say:28:1360229001:0.text: Argh! That's so awful! I can't take it anymore!

say:29:1360229002:0.text: What did I do to deserve this torture? It's not like I swallowed your shadows!
say:29:1360229002:0.source_cn: 我都没有直接吞掉你们的影子，你们居然唱这样难听的歌！

say:31:1360229004:1.text: We should be the ones saying that!
say:31:1360229004:1.source_cn: 这话该由我们说才对吧！

say:33:1360227008:1.text: You're right. While Lucius only heard them singing off-key, I heard them laughing uncontrollably...
say:33:1360227008:1.source_cn: 是的，卢修斯只听到了走调，而我却听到了扭曲的狂笑声……
say:33:1360227008:1.male: You're right. While Lucius only heard them singing off-key, I heard them laughing uncontrollably...
say:33:1360227008:1.female: You're right. While Lucius only heard them singing off-key, I heard them laughing uncontrollably...

say:0:1360230001:0.text: Stupid knights! Your singing is downright awful!
say:0:1360230001:0.source_cn: 你们这些愚蠢的唱诗班！难听，难听难听难听！

say:1:1360230002:0.source_cn: 圣歌对恶魔这么有效果啊……

say:2:1360231001:1.text: Alright, let's leave it at that!
say:2:1360231001:1.source_cn: 好了，到此为止吧，我消气了！

say:3:1360231002:1.text: I've decided to forgive you all! The guy who sings like a trumpet has won me over.
say:3:1360231002:1.source_cn: 仔细想想，这个扯着嗓子像个小号一样的家伙，唱得也挺有意...

say:4:1360231003:1.text: Don't desecrate the hymn with your filthy words!
say:4:1360231003:1.source_cn: 别用你肮脏的言辞亵渎圣歌！

say:5:1360231004:1.text: Ah, it's you... Answer me correctly, and I'll give you a little something.
say:5:1360231004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，是曾经见过的面孔……那么就给你个特别优惠吧？

say:6:1360231005:0.text: What did I attach myself to just now?
say:6:1360231005:0.source_cn: 考考你，我刚刚附在了哪里？

say:7:1360231006:0.text: No way am I answering questions from a Hypogean!
say:7:1360231006:0.source_cn: 我不会回答恶魔的提问！

say:8:1360231007:0.text: Could it be your shadow? Those unfortunate acolytes? The clothes you're wearing? Your dear pony? Or the winged hat on this bulky guy?
say:8:1360231007:0.source_cn: 是你们的影子里？倒霉的修士身上？你们的衣服？你亲爱的小...

say:9:1360231008:0.text: The title page of the old man's codex? The gem on the acolyte's belt?
say:9:1360231008:0.source_cn: 那边老头子的圣典扉页？这边修女妹妹的腰带宝石？

say:10:1360231009:0.text: Let me make it clear to you—we won't be wasting time on pointless guesswork!
say:10:1360231009:0.source_cn: 我说过，我们不会浪费时间在猜疑和质证上！

say:11:1360231010:0.text: You already have the answer, don't you, my dear? You were wondering why only you heard the laughter.
say:11:1360231010:0.source_cn: 其实你也有答案吧，亲爱的？刚刚你就开始怀疑，为什么只有...

say:12:1360231011:0.text: Ever considered that you could be the one leading me to the seal?
say:12:1360231011:0.source_cn: 比起其他人来说，其实你把“我”带到封印处的可能性更大哦——

choice_prompt:13:1360231011.text: Ever considered that you could be the one leading me to the seal?
choice_prompt:13:1360231011.source_cn: 比起其他人来说，其实你把“我”带到封印处的可能性更大哦——

say:14:1360231012:0.text: Don't be such a killjoy, Merlin! I'll get upset if you ruin my fun again!
say:14:1360231012:0.source_cn: 讨厌啊，梅林！如果你总是这样打扰我的乐趣，我真的要生气了！
say:14:1360231012:0.male: Don't be such a killjoy, Merlin! I'll get upset if you ruin my fun again!
say:14:1360231012:0.female: Don't be such a killjoy, Merlin! I'll get upset if you ruin my fun again!

say:16:1360231015:0.text: I see! This place's packed with acolytes, so Berial's shadow could hardly sneak in!
say:16:1360231015:0.source_cn: 原来如此！因为这里是修士们最为集中的地方，只能使用影子...

say:17:1360236101:0.text: Plus, constantly twisting sounds would be far too draining for his weak shadow.
say:17:1360236101:0.source_cn: 在这种场合下，用腐坏的魔力扭曲不知何时会发生的声音，对...

say:18:1360231016:0.text: So, he had no choice but to resort to trickery—by messing with people's hearing! It's the easier route!
say:18:1360231016:0.source_cn: 所以，他只能故弄玄虚了，因为直接改变对方耳朵里捕捉到的...

say:19:1360231017:0.text: Can't believe he went to such great lengths just to cause trouble!
say:19:1360231017:0.source_cn: 预算有限，就只能另辟蹊径——为了作恶，还真是想方设法呢...

say:20:1360231018:0.text: Ouch, talk about making me sound like I'm pinching pennies, you fluffy menace!
say:20:1360231018:0.source_cn: 别这么说嘛，毛茸茸的小使魔，就好像我是个每天数着生活费...

choice_prompt:21:1360231018.text: Ouch, talk about making me sound like I'm pinching pennies, you fluffy menace!
choice_prompt:21:1360231018.source_cn: 别这么说嘛，毛茸茸的小使魔，就好像我是个每天数着生活费的穷光蛋一样！

say:22:1360231019:2.text:
Merlin!
Alright, you're spot on! I'm indeed living on a budget now.
say:22:1360231019:2.source_cn: 梅——林！\n好吧，没错，你说得对！哈哈哈哈，没错，我...
say:22:1360231019:2.male:
Merlin!
Alright, you're spot on! I'm indeed living on a budget now.
say:22:1360231019:2.female:
Merlin!
Alright, you're spot on! I'm indeed living on a budget now.

say:23:1360231020:0.text: Don't you know why I have to scrimp and save?
say:23:1360231020:0.source_cn: 但你们难道不知道我是为什么这样节约吗，各位？

say:24:1360231021:0.text: You've hurt so many of my unfortunate friends! I can only wander around all by myself!
say:24:1360231021:0.source_cn: 你们一次又一次伤害了我可怜的朋友们，而我只能孤独地在大...

say:25:1360231022:0.text: I'm so lonely, and I just want to do something to cheer my friends up... Music's the only thing I can offer...
say:25:1360231022:0.source_cn: 如此寂寞的我，想要为我那些无法移动的不幸朋友们送上些许...

choice_prompt:26:1360231022.text: I'm so lonely, and I just want to do something to cheer my friends up... Music's the only thing I can offer...
choice_prompt:26:1360231022.source_cn: 如此寂寞的我，想要为我那些无法移动的不幸朋友们送上些许音乐，作为打发时间的慰问品……

say:27:1360231023:0.text: Why wouldn't they? It's a song of freedom from Berial, the lonely clown!
say:27:1360231023:0.source_cn: 难道不是吗？孤独的小丑贝利尔为这些被封印的可怜虫，献上...
say:27:1360231023:0.male: Why wouldn't they? It's a song of freedom from Berial, the lonely clown!
say:27:1360231023:0.female: Why wouldn't they? It's a song of freedom from Berial, the lonely clown!

say:28:1360231024:0.text: My performance offers them solace while they are stuck in the pain of perpetual stillness!
say:28:1360231024:0.source_cn: 让他们在无法动弹的痛苦中，还能欣赏我的演出！
say:28:1360231024:0.male: My performance offers them solace while they are stuck in the pain of perpetual stillness!
say:28:1360231024:0.female: My performance offers them solace while they are stuck in the pain of perpetual stillness!

say:29:1360231027:0.text: You should admire my lovely gesture. Yet instead, you keep trying to thwart my plan!
say:29:1360231027:0.source_cn: 这样深刻又感人的友情，你们不为之落泪就算了，居然还反复...

say:30:1360231028:0.text: Some Magister and templar knights you are! You should be ashamed of yourselves!
say:30:1360231028:0.source_cn: 难以置信啊，我眼前的还是爱与正义的伟大魔法师与圣骑士大人吗？

choice_prompt:31:1360231028.text: Some Magister and templar knights you are! You should be ashamed of yourselves!
choice_prompt:31:1360231028.source_cn: 难以置信啊，我眼前的还是爱与正义的伟大魔法师与圣骑士大人吗？

say:32:1360231029:0.text: Aw, look at your fluffy faces—you must be touched by my words! I have to say, you're truly a genius at changing topics.
say:32:1360231029:0.source_cn: 呜哇，看那两张毛茸茸的小脸上感动的表情！我得说，你真是...
say:32:1360231029:0.male: Aw, look at your fluffy faces—you must be touched by my words! I have to say, you're truly a genius at changing topics.
say:32:1360231029:0.female: Aw, look at your fluffy faces—you must be touched by my words! I have to say, you're truly a genius at changing topics.

say:33:1360231031:0.text: Seriously, Merlin... Why are you so good at killing my vibe...
say:33:1360231031:0.source_cn: 真是的……梅林，你不但是坏事的天才，还是扫兴的天才……
say:33:1360231031:0.male: Seriously, Merlin... Why are you so good at killing my vibe...
say:33:1360231031:0.female: Seriously, Merlin... Why are you so good at killing my vibe...

say:34:1360231032:0.text: But I'll let you off the hook this time since you always manage to keep up with me.
say:34:1360231032:0.source_cn: 但看在你总也能跟得上我的节奏，这次我就慈悲地原谅你吧。
say:34:1360231032:0.male: But I'll let you off the hook this time since you always manage to keep up with me.
say:34:1360231032:0.female: But I'll let you off the hook this time since you always manage to keep up with me.

say:35:1360231033:0.text: Aren't I a Hypogean with a kind soul? Hahaha! It's definitely the joke of the year!
say:35:1360231033:0.source_cn: 慈悲的恶魔——哈哈哈哈！这个笑话绝对是年度第一！

say:38:1360231035:1.text: Amidst a fit of uproarious laughter, Berial transforms into a wisp of smoke and vanishes...
say:38:1360231035:1.source_cn: 在一阵自顾自的疯癫狂笑中，贝利尔的身影化为淡淡的烟雾消...

say:40:1360231036:1.text: After composing yourselves, you begin discussing your next move.
say:40:1360231036:1.source_cn: 你们整理了下情绪，开始商讨接下来的对策。

say:41:1360231037:1.text: We'll report what happened here to our superiors and further reinforce the seal.
say:41:1360231037:1.source_cn: 我们会把这里发生的事上报，并且进一步加固封印。

say:42:1360231038:0.text: Singing hymns and praying works well against that guy's magic. No matter how cunning he is, Dura's blessing will render him powerless.
say:42:1360231038:0.source_cn: 圣歌和祈祷明显能够隔绝那家伙的力量，不管他再怎么无孔不...

say:44:1360231039:1.text: We can immediately tell if a hymn is affected. It's by far the best solution!
say:44:1360231039:1.source_cn: 嗯，而且圣歌一旦受影响，也能立刻就被分辨出来，目前来说...

say:45:1360231040:1.text: However, the Berial we just saw was also a doppelganger. Will he be causing trouble elsewhere...
say:45:1360231040:1.source_cn: 只是，这里的贝利尔也只是个分身，他还会祸害别的地方吗……

say:46:1360231041:1.text: Magister, I think Berial has left us clues again.
say:46:1360231041:1.source_cn: 主人，我觉得贝利尔还是给我们故意留下了线索。
say:46:1360231041:1.male: Magister, I think Berial has left us clues again.
say:46:1360231041:1.female: Magister, I think Berial has left us clues again.

say:47:1360231042:1.text: You remember he mentioned his "unfortunate friends"? Coincidentally, there are sealed Hypogeans in every affected area we visited.
say:47:1360231042:1.source_cn: 你还记得吗，他说过“无法移动的不幸朋友”们，而一路走来...
say:47:1360231042:1.male: You remember he mentioned his "unfortunate friends"? Coincidentally, there are sealed Hypogeans in every affected area we visited.
say:47:1360231042:1.female: You remember he mentioned his "unfortunate friends"? Coincidentally, there are sealed Hypogeans in every affected area we visited.

say:48:1360231043:1.text: So, the next place he might target is...
say:48:1360231043:1.source_cn: 那么，接下来的地方就应该是——
say:48:1360231043:1.male: So, the next place he might target is...
say:48:1360231043:1.female: So, the next place he might target is...

say:50:1360231030:0.text: If you think an indifferent response can spoil my fun, then... you're right!
say:50:1360231030:0.source_cn: 如果你以为平淡的应对就能阻碍我的愉快，那你就——想得没错！
say:50:1360231030:0.male: If you think an indifferent response can spoil my fun, then... you're right!
say:50:1360231030:0.female: If you think an indifferent response can spoil my fun, then... you're right!

choice:26:0:1.text: Are you sure they enjoy it?
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 你真的是在慰问他们吗？
choice:26:0:1.male: Are you sure they enjoy it?
choice:26:0:1.female: Are you sure they enjoy it?

say:51:1360231025:0.text: Hahaha! Don't get me wrong, I just want my peers to experience the beauty of the outside world too!
say:51:1360231025:0.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈！这怎么能叫嘲讽呢！我只是想让亲爱的同事们，也...

say:51:1360231025:0.female: Hahaha! Don't get me wrong, I just want my peers to experience the beauty of the outside world too!

say:52:1360231026:0.text: Look, they're so into it that they haven't moved an inch... Oops, my bad—they couldn't move! Hahaha!
say:52:1360231026:0.source_cn: 瞧，他们听得多专注，根本移不开……哦，抱歉，本来就移不...

say:52:1360231026:0.female: Look, they're so into it that they haven't moved an inch... Oops, my bad—they couldn't move! Hahaha!

say:53:1360231013:0.text: Don't give it away, Merlin! You're ruining the fun!
say:53:1360231013:0.source_cn: 别在这里提示了，梅林！你已经知道了答案，却还要妨碍我的乐趣！
say:53:1360231013:0.male: Don't give it away, Merlin! You're ruining the fun!
say:53:1360231013:0.female: Don't give it away, Merlin! You're ruining the fun!

say:54:1360231014:0.text: Alright, alright. I messed with her hearing! You happy now?
say:54:1360231014:0.source_cn: 好吧，好吧，我改变了这个女人的听觉，就这样！

say:54:1360231014:0.female: Alright, alright. I messed with her hearing! You happy now?

say:2:1360232001:1.text: As you arrive in the Land of Riches, Tasi instantly appears before you.
say:2:1360232001:1.source_cn: 你们来到了流金之地，塔西也第一时间出现在了你们眼前。

say:4:1360232003:1.text: Tasi, fancy seeing you again! Is Harak's seal still holding up?
say:4:1360232003:1.source_cn: 塔西，好久不见！哈拉克的封印没有问题吧？

say:5:1360232004:1.text: Everything's fine—I just checked and didn't notice any changes.
say:5:1360232004:1.source_cn: 嗯，我不久前才确认过，一切安好，没有任何变化。

say:6:1360232005:1.text: I did, nevertheless, catch the scent of a nightmare nearby.
say:6:1360232005:1.source_cn: 只是刚刚在附近闻到了一些噩梦的味道。

say:7:1360232006:1.text: So, is there a specific reason you ask about the seal?
say:7:1360232006:1.source_cn: 所以，你们为什么会来问这个？

say:8:1360232007:1.text: You brief Tasi on Berial's scheme and actions. She listens with a contemplative expression.
say:8:1360232007:1.source_cn: 你们向塔西讲述了贝利尔的阴谋和行径，塔西闻言，露出了若...

say:9:1360232008:1.text: My friends, you know why I thought of checking Harak's seal?
say:9:1360232008:1.source_cn: 朋友们，你们知道为什么我不久前才会确认哈拉克的封印吗？

say:10:1360232009:1.text: It's because I ran into you a few minutes ago and you said the exact same thing.
say:10:1360232009:1.source_cn: 因为就在刚刚，我才与你们相遇，并且回答了你们的问题。

say:11:1360232010:1.text: Berial beat us to it... Magister, let's use Dunlingr's bell right away!
say:11:1360232010:1.source_cn: 居然被抢先了……主人，快点用顿里尔大人的钟镇压吧！
say:11:1360232010:1.male: Berial beat us to it... Magister, let's use Dunlingr's bell right away!
say:11:1360232010:1.female: Berial beat us to it... Magister, let's use Dunlingr's bell right away!

narration:12:1360233001:1.text: Without further ado, you channel your magic into the clock.
narration:12:1360233001:1.male: Without further ado, you channel your magic into the clock.
narration:12:1360233001:1.female: Without further ado, you channel your magic into the clock.

narration:14:1360233002:2.text: Again, light shines from above following the clock's chime...
narration:14:1360233002:2.male: Again, light shines from above following the clock's chime...
narration:14:1360233002:2.female: Again, light shines from above following the clock's chime...

say:18:1360234001:2.text: As the ground nearby rumbles, Hypofiends lurking underneath are exposed...
say:18:1360234001:2.source_cn: 周围的地面涌动着，果然，魔物就潜藏在周围……

say:19:1360234002:1.source_cn: 不止如此，浮现出的，还有——

say:21:1360234003:1.text: The doppelgangers of Chippy and Hammie!

say:22:1360234004:1.text: I had no clue they were hiding here the whole time!

say:23:1360234005:1.source_cn: 居然敢变成漫漫的样子，过分！！！

say:2:1360235001:1.text: Phew, that was a real scare... So, as you mentioned earlier, the Hypogean might still be around, right?
say:2:1360235001:1.source_cn: 呼，真是让人震惊……不过，按照你们刚刚说的，恶魔仍然有...

say:3:1360235002:1.text: Yeah, thanks to Temesia's hymn, we managed to flush him out.
say:3:1360235002:1.source_cn: 是的，之前如果不是主人让特弥希娅小姐唱圣歌，可能还没法...

say:4:1360235003:1.text: Hmm, how about you play your flute here, Merlin?
say:4:1360235003:1.source_cn: 唔，这样的话，梅林，你要不要在这里演奏一下？
say:4:1360235003:1.male: Hmm, how about you play your flute here, Merlin?
say:4:1360235003:1.female: Hmm, how about you play your flute here, Merlin?

say:5:1360235004:1.text: We can check if this place is under corrupted magic, as the first thing that goes wrong is usually the instrument.
say:5:1360235004:1.source_cn: 你看，如果声音发生了扭曲，那么最先出问题的通常是乐器。
say:5:1360235004:1.male: We can check if this place is under corrupted magic, as the first thing that goes wrong is usually the instrument.
say:5:1360235004:1.female: We can check if this place is under corrupted magic, as the first thing that goes wrong is usually the instrument.

say:6:1360235005:1.text: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!
say:6:1360235005:1.source_cn: 而你的演奏，如果注入了魔力，说不定也有圣歌的力量——这...
say:6:1360235005:1.male: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!
say:6:1360235005:1.female: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!

choice_prompt:7:1360235005.male: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!
choice_prompt:7:1360235005.female: And there's a chance the sound of your flute could have the same effect as a hymn! We'd be killing two birds with one stone!

say:9:1360235006:1.text: You take out the flute you always carry with you and play a simple song.
say:9:1360235006:1.source_cn: 你取出随身携带的笛子，简单地演奏了一曲。
say:9:1360235006:1.male: You take out the flute you always carry with you and play a simple song.
say:9:1360235006:1.female: You take out the flute you always carry with you and play a simple song.

say:10:1360235007:1.text: The flute weaves a mesmerizing and enchanting melody, its delicate notes lingering in the air...
say:10:1360235007:1.source_cn: 清澈动听的笛音如此悠扬，即使已然结束，仿佛也依旧有袅袅...

say:11:1360235008:1.text: Phew... That melody took away Chippy's breath.
say:11:1360235008:1.male: Phew... That melody took away Chippy's breath.
say:11:1360235008:1.female: Phew... That melody took away Chippy's breath.

say:12:1360235009:1.source_cn: 太好听了，主人！好美的笛声啊！

say:13:1360235010:0.text: Nothing happened. Looks like this place's alright!
say:13:1360235010:0.source_cn: 周围也没有什么变化，看起来是已经净化干净了！
say:13:1360235010:0.male: Nothing happened. Looks like this place's alright!
say:13:1360235010:0.female: Nothing happened. Looks like this place's alright!

say:14:1360235011:0.text: It was truly wonderful to be an audience of Magister's performance...
say:14:1360235011:0.source_cn: 嗯，不过能听到主人的美妙演奏，也很幸福啊……
say:14:1360235011:0.male: It was truly wonderful to be an audience of Magister's performance...
say:14:1360235011:0.female: It was truly wonderful to be an audience of Magister's performance...

say:15:1360235012:1.text: Speaking of music, didn't Berial say he wanted to perform for his sealed Hypogean friends?
say:15:1360235012:1.source_cn: 说起来，那个贝利尔不是说他要给每个被封印的恶魔带去音乐吗。

say:16:1360235013:1.text: Aren't Hypogeans emotionless creatures that follow only their instincts? They must despise each other too!
say:16:1360235013:1.source_cn: 但恶魔不是连彼此之间都憎恶的，完全混乱，只有欲望没有情...

say:17:1360235014:1.text: You make a good point, Hammie. Most Hypogeans don't even have dreams.
say:17:1360235014:1.source_cn: 确实如你所说，大部分恶魔甚至连梦境都没有。

say:18:1360235015:1.text: Even if they do, their dreams are often evil, corrupted, and chaotic—a twisted maze far worse than any of our nightmares.
say:18:1360235015:1.source_cn: 如果有，也是邪恶而又腐败，甚至混乱到让无法涉足的，超越...

say:19:1360235016:1.text: Though... they do occasionally dream of nice things too.
say:19:1360235016:1.source_cn: 不过呢，就算是那种东西，偶尔也会有美梦哦？

say:20:1360235017:1.source_cn: 就像是毒药外面也会裹上一层糖衣那样。

say:21:1360235018:0.text: It's corrupted inside, but the sweetness outside is sometimes worth savoring.
say:21:1360235018:0.source_cn: 你不能否认里面有着致命的丑恶，但你同样也不能否认，在它...

say:22:1360235019:0.text: Hmm, Chippy can't make heads or tails of this, but Chippy's sure Berial has no conscience!
say:22:1360235019:0.source_cn: 唔，有点难懂。但满满觉得，贝利尔绝对没有任何好心肠可言！

say:23:1360235020:0.text: Either he wants to flaunt his freedom in front of his sealed peers, or he wants to get under their skin with his awful songs!
say:23:1360235020:0.source_cn: 没错，他要不然是想跟那些被封印的家伙炫耀，要不然就是想...

say:24:1360235021:1.text: Although Berial's true motive remains a mystery, the matter here has been resolved. It's time to say goodbye to Tasi.
say:24:1360235021:1.source_cn: 无论贝利尔的目的究竟为何，这里的问题既然已经告一段落，...

say:25:1360235022:0.text: I'll keep an eye on Harak's seal here.
say:25:1360235022:0.source_cn: 我会留在这里再次确认哈拉克的封印是否完整，交给我吧。

say:26:1360235023:1.text: We have faith in you, Tasi! See you next time!
say:26:1360235023:1.source_cn: 那么，拜托了，塔西！我们走啦！

say:28:1360235024:0.text: You stroll toward the cave entrance. As soon as you're out of Tasi's sight, you signal to your familiars and hide in a corner.
say:28:1360235024:0.source_cn: 你们朝洞窟外走去，然而，刚刚离开塔西的视线，你就示意了...

say:29:1360235025:0.text: Meanwhile, a sly smirk creeps across Tasi's face.
say:29:1360235025:0.source_cn: 紧接着，留在原地的塔西，露出了奇异的微笑！

say:30:1360235026:2.text: What a terrific flutist! It takes years of practice to master that kind of technique.
say:30:1360235026:2.source_cn: 真是不错的笛声呀，这可不是初学者能有的技术。

say:31:1360235027:0.text: Hasn't he lost his memory? How is he still able to play the instruments as well as he did before?
say:31:1360235027:0.source_cn: 明明都失忆了，但无论笛子、鲁特琴还是别的乐器都像以前一...
say:31:1360235027:0.male: Hasn't he lost his memory? How is he still able to play the instruments as well as he did before?
say:31:1360235027:0.female: Hasn't she lost her memory? How is she still able to play the instruments as well as she did before?

say:32:1360235028:0.text: It can't possibly be muscle memory, can it? Hahahaha!
say:32:1360235028:0.source_cn: 总不会是因为演奏属于身体的记忆吧——哈哈哈哈哈哈！

say:33:1360235029:0.text: I wish someone were here to listen to my jokes, but the audience has to have a sense of humor too!
say:33:1360235029:0.source_cn: 真是的，所有的笑话没有听众就失去了一半色彩，而如果听众...

say:34:1360235030:0.text: Music is such a powerful tool. After all, even creatures as brainless as fish respond to it.
say:34:1360235030:0.source_cn: 音乐这东西倒是很方便，就算是没脑子的蠢鱼听到了估计也会...

say:35:1360235031:0.text: Wait, can fish actually hear anything? I guess they use their senses only to hunt food.
say:35:1360235031:0.source_cn: ……啧，不过那家伙真的有所谓的听力吗。五感全都聚集到食...

say:36:1360235032:0.text: Never mind. Anyway, this mission is a success...
say:36:1360235032:0.source_cn: 算了，不管怎么说，本次行动，成功成功——

say:38:1360235033:0.text: It's you, Berial! You fooled us!
say:38:1360235033:0.source_cn: 居然是你！贝利尔！你骗我们！

say:39:1360235034:1.text: In response to Chippy's sudden appearance, Berial breaks into a wry smile, as if he's been expecting this showdown.
say:39:1360235034:1.source_cn: 面对着跳出来的满满，眼前贝利尔所化成的塔西却再次露出了...

say:41:1360235035:0.text: Once again, Berial's figure leaps out from the twisted shadow.
say:41:1360235035:0.source_cn: 暗影扭曲着，贝利尔的身形再次从空气中一跃而出！

say:42:1360235036:0.text: I was about to celebrate my success just now.
say:42:1360235036:0.source_cn: 刚刚我还在想，要不要说“耍了一次梅林，开心！”之类的。
say:42:1360235036:0.male: I was about to celebrate my success just now.
say:42:1360235036:0.female: I was about to celebrate my success just now.

say:43:1360235037:0.text: You knew it was me all along, didn't you?
say:43:1360235037:0.source_cn: 不过，其实你早就发现是我了对吧？
say:43:1360235037:0.male: You knew it was me all along, didn't you?
say:43:1360235037:0.female: You knew it was me all along, didn't you?

say:44:1360235038:0.text: When you took my suggestion and played the flute.
say:44:1360235038:0.source_cn: 就在你顺着我的意思吹笛子的时候。
say:44:1360235038:0.male: When you took my suggestion and played the flute.
say:44:1360235038:0.female: When you took my suggestion and played the flute.

say:46:1360235039:1.text: B-but, why didn't the flute purify you?
say:46:1360235039:1.source_cn: 那、那为什么，为什么主人的笛音没有净化你！

say:47:1360235040:0.text: Tsk! Can't you pretend to be tricked for once so I can have some fun?
say:47:1360235040:0.source_cn: 啊——真是的，每次都这么敏锐，就不能让我畅快地玩一下吗？
say:47:1360235040:0.male: Tsk! Can't you pretend to be tricked for once so I can have some fun?
say:47:1360235040:0.female: Tsk! Can't you pretend to be tricked for once so I can have some fun?

say:48:1360235041:1.text: Or you just don't feel like playing along with my shadow?
say:48:1360235041:1.source_cn: 还是说，不是本体来陪你，你就像我一样提不起兴致？
say:48:1360235041:1.male: Or you just don't feel like playing along with my shadow?
say:48:1360235041:1.female: Or you just don't feel like playing along with my shadow?

say:49:1360235042:1.text: I assure you—my shadow is nothing like the illusion that Phraesto conjures up.
say:49:1360235042:1.source_cn: 不要看不起影子啊，我和普鲁斯托那个大块头不一样，对幻术...

say:50:1360235043:1.text: You know how I feel every time I possess or transform into someone? I have to fight the urge to tear them apart and devour them!
say:50:1360235043:1.source_cn: 每次附体也好变形也罢，可是要拼命压抑着把对方从内到外一...

say:51:1360235044:1.text: Compared to Harak, I'm almost as restrained as Dura's acolytes!
say:51:1360235044:1.source_cn: 真是的，和哈拉克比，我简直像是艾雅的部下们一样禁欲啊。

say:2:1360236001:1.text: Ah, this isn't fun anymore. Let's call it a day.
say:2:1360236001:1.source_cn: 啊，差不多了，我这次也玩腻了，就这样吧。
say:2:1360236001:1.male: Ah, this isn't fun anymore. Let's call it a day.
say:2:1360236001:1.female: Ah, this isn't fun anymore. Let's call it a day.

say:3:1360236002:1.text: By the way, seeing my friends getting punished here really got me thinking...
say:3:1360236002:1.source_cn: 不过话说回来，看着我这些朋友们的——该怎么说呢，墓碑？...
say:3:1360236002:1.male: By the way, seeing my friends getting punished here really got me thinking...
say:3:1360236002:1.female: By the way, seeing my friends getting punished here really got me thinking...

say:4:1360236003:1.text: It seems that you've achieved a lot in a short time, Merlin.
say:4:1360236003:1.source_cn: 感觉梅林你在这短暂的恢复记忆期间，还真是战果累累啊。
say:4:1360236003:1.male: It seems that you've achieved a lot in a short time, Merlin.

say:6:1360236004:1.source_cn: 是啊，就算所有恶魔加起来恐怕都没有你这样有行动力。
say:6:1360236004:1.male: Yeah, even if all of us Hypogeans combined, we probably couldn't accomplish as much as you.
say:6:1360236004:1.female: Yeah, even if all of us Hypogeans combined, we probably couldn't accomplish as much as you.

say:7:1360236006:1.text: Alright, it's time to say goodbye. See you again soon!
say:7:1360236006:1.source_cn: 那么，这次就暂时告别吧，期待下次与你的相遇——
say:7:1360236006:1.male: Alright, it's time to say goodbye. See you again soon!
say:7:1360236006:1.female: Alright, it's time to say goodbye. See you again soon!

say:8:1360236007:1.text: I hope you'll be in one piece when the time comes, not the half-dead, burned, and amnesiac version I saw last time.
say:8:1360236007:1.source_cn: 当然，最好别再是半死不活失去记忆伤痕累累差点沦为灰烬的你了。

say:10:1360236008:1.text: Hahaha, I'll gladly accept your blessing!
say:10:1360236008:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈哈，我就接受你的祝福吧！梅林！
say:10:1360236008:1.male: Hahaha, I'll gladly accept your blessing!
say:10:1360236008:1.female: Hahaha, I'll gladly accept your blessing!

say:11:1360236009:1.text: Not only will I make sure I'm in good shape, but I'll also prepare a huge surprise for you!

say:56:1360237046:1.text: The only thing I could think of is "Spring Festival", but it's pretty basic...

narration:0:1360240001:0.text: The next morning, everyone gathers at the same spot.
narration:0:1360240001:0.source_cn: 一番准备后，第二天清晨，大家齐聚此处——

say:4:1360241001:1.text: As the sunlight bathes the venue, Lorsan gives a speech as the event host.
say:4:1360241001:1.source_cn: 迎着春日的晨辉，洛桑作为主持，致辞发言。

say:5:1360241002:1.text: Ladies and gentlemen, starting today, we'll be celebrating a new festival every year—the <style="highlight">Dawnlight Revelry</style>.

say:6:1360241003:1.text: This festival commemorates Merlin's effort in repelling the Hypogeans that plagued this continent with music, bringing forth hope to the land!

say:8:1360241004:0.text: I've made an announcement with my chimes.
say:8:1360241004:0.source_cn: 吾已然用钟声，将这一节日昭告四方。

say:9:1360241005:0.text: Everyone in Esperia should now be aware of this new festival!
say:9:1360241005:0.source_cn: 大陆的每一处应当都已然知晓，新的节日已然诞生！

say:10:1360241006:1.text: This year, the theme is music. Use your most beautiful voice to welcome the bright and vibrant spring!
say:10:1360241006:1.source_cn: 而本次节日，以音乐为主题，大家请用自己最美妙的声音，来...

say:13:1360241008:1.text: Some play the flute, some shake the bells, but most join in by belting out along with the mellow symphony...
say:13:1360241008:1.source_cn: 有人吹笛，有人摇铃，但更多的，是人们随着美妙的合奏，自...

say:15:1360241009:0.text: The captivating music brings warmth to every corner of Cedartown...
say:15:1360241009:0.source_cn: 美妙的音乐犹如阳光一般，洒遍雪松镇的每个角落——

say:16:1360241010:0.text: Everyone, it's time for me to hit the road again! I'll spread the word about the Dawnlight Revelry wherever I go!
say:16:1360241010:0.source_cn: 各位，我也该再次出发了！相信我，无论走到哪里，我也会帮...

say:17:1360241011:0.text: I'm calling dibs on hosting the festival next year, even if the theme isn't music anymore!
say:17:1360241011:0.source_cn: 等到明年，就算主题不是音乐了，也请一定要交给我主持呀！

narration:19:1360242001:0.text: Thanks to Dunlingr's announcement, the air is now filled with the cheerful chatter of the people and beautiful music...
narration:19:1360242001:0.source_cn: 新节日的诞生随着顿里尔的昭告响彻四方，随之而起的，是人...

say:24:1360243001:1.text: Impressive! To create a festival endorsed by a Celestial is really something.
say:24:1360243001:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，虽然梅林这家伙干什么都很正常，但直接创造一个有...

say:25:1360243002:1.text: But surely they should give me some credit for this festival, right?
say:25:1360243002:1.source_cn: 只不过，这次的节日至少有一多半的功劳应该归我吧？！

say:26:1360243003:0.text: That's the right thing to do! I should have naming rights too! Why not call it the Berial Revelry?
say:26:1360243003:0.source_cn: 对吧对吧，明明应该是我！我也应该有冠名权！这个节日有一...

say:27:1360243004:0.text: Ugh, forget it. Even I find it cringy.

say:28:1360243005:0.text: As forgiving as I am, I won't hold it against them.
say:28:1360243005:0.source_cn: 算了，宽宏大量的我就这样面对人类的不公平吧！

say:29:1360243006:0.text: No matter what, I've done my very best...
say:29:1360243006:0.source_cn: 不过嘛，无论如何，我也算是尽心尽力了……

say:30:1360243007:0.text: The music humans enjoy must sound like unbearable clamor to your ears, right?
say:30:1360243007:0.source_cn: 在诸位的耳中，人类认为美妙的东西多半犹如嘈杂刺耳的噪音...

say:31:1360243008:0.text: Would you be able to appreciate the beauty within the noise?
say:31:1360243008:0.source_cn: 但是反过来说，如果真的是噪音，诸位能否欣赏呢？

say:32:1360243009:0.text: Hahaha! Just let me do a little something for you while you continue your slumber!
say:32:1360243009:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈，就当成我在诸位做着深沉美梦时的一点小小...

say:33:1360243010:0.text: Unlike you all, I'm extremely polite and humane!
say:33:1360243010:0.source_cn: 与你们不同，我可是非——常非常有礼貌，非常人性化的人！

say:34:1360243011:0.text: Please bear with me, whether you're awakened, annoyed, or grateful to my music...
say:34:1360243011:0.source_cn: 那么，无论有没有被吵醒，是恨得牙痒痒，还是对我的关怀感...

say:35:1360243012:1.source_cn: 都享受这片刻的时光吧！

narration:36:1360244001:1.text: The sinister crimson fog in the desert, the rift subdued by the Sun Temple's presence, the ravenous shark still confined in the glass bottle, and the bone-chilling air in the land of snow...

narration:37:1360244002:1.text: Owing to your past adventures, these evil forces have been sealed away for good.

narration:38:1360244003:1.text: And this time, you've successfully thwarted yet another of the Hypogeans' attempts to wreak havoc.

narration:39:1360244004:1.text: Under the sunlight, a frivolous figure retreats into the shadows.

narration:40:1360244005:1.text: The continent shall remain peaceful for the time being.
